slides.title: Give every edit note a home
slides.body: A three-step review workflow for podcast teams.

slides.title: Open the episode
slides.body: Jump to the producer’s note at 12:40 inside the episode review.

slides.title: Assign the exact cut
slides.body: Select 12:40 to 12:56 and give Leah ownership of the change.

slides.title: Close the loop
slides.body: Mark the note resolved and keep the original timestamp visible.

slides.title: Try it on your next edit
slides.body: Give each note three things: a timestamp, an owner, and a resolution.
slides.source: Recap of the three actions shown at 00:04, 00:12, and 00:22.
